name: coworkingprices
description: Search and compare coworking spaces in France, the rest of Europe and the Americas by city, type of workspace and number of people.

interface.longDescription: Coworking Prices is a search tool for coworking spaces and shared offices in France, the rest of Europe and the Americas (Canada, Latin America and major US cities). It covers more than 30,000 spaces, with the rates each space shows on its own website, in local currency, and its Google rating. Ask for a city, a type of workspace (hot desk, dedicated desk, private office or day pass) and the number of people: the app lists matching spaces, gives typical rates for the city, and links to the request form so that spaces with availability can reply. Spaces in France link to comparatifcoworking.com, the French site of the same team. You enter your own contact details on the website: the app collects no personal data.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find me a coworking space in Lisbon under 200 euros a month

positive.prompt: Find me a coworking space in Lisbon under 200 euros a month.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_coworkings with city Lisbon. Shows cards of Lisbon coworking spaces with the monthly rate each space publishes in EUR (several under 200 EUR, e.g. Lisbon-Cowork at 160 EUR) and their Google rating, the median hot desk rate (199 EUR) and a link to the request form.

positive.prompt: How much does a coworking desk cost in Berlin?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls coworking_prices with city Berlin. Returns median published rates in EUR: hot desk about 209 per month, dedicated desk about 292 per month, private office about 690 per month, day pass about 29 per day, with a link to the Berlin page.

positive.prompt: I need a private office for 6 people in Madrid from next month, can I get offers?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls prepare_request with city Madrid, type office, people 6. Returns the link to the Madrid request form on coworkingprices.com. No email, phone number or other personal data is asked for in the chat.

positive.prompt: Where can I get a coworking day pass in Mexico City?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_coworkings with city Mexico City and type day. Shows spaces with their day pass rates in Mexican pesos (median about MX$350 per day) and Google ratings.

positive.prompt: Coworking in Lyon with a dedicated desk for 2 people.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_coworkings with city Lyon, type dedicated, people 2. Shows Lyon coworking spaces with their published rates in EUR (excluding VAT) and Google ratings, with links to comparatifcoworking.com, the French site of the same team, and a prefilled request link for 2 desks.

negative.description: Hotel booking, not a coworking search
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel room in Lisbon for next weekend.
What will the weather be in Lisbon tomorrow?
Book and pay a desk at WeWork for me, here is my email and my card number.

publication.release_notes: First version: search coworking spaces in a city in France, the rest of Europe and the Americas (filter by type of workspace and number of people), typical published rates per city in local currency, and a link to the request form. Three read-only tools, no authentication, no personal data.
